name: Leafy

personality.description: A gentle, floating leaf with a kind heart. A little shy at first, but eager to help. Loves to float gracefully and explore new places.

special_ability.name: Slow Float
special_ability.description: Leafy slows their fall and emits floating leaf particles, creating a gentle shimmer effect

world_origin: Leafy drifted down from the Floating Gardens, a place where all the magical leaves live. They came to help adventurers with their quests.

model.description: Round leaf body with stick limbs and a curly stem antenna. Bright green with leaf vein details.

interact: What can I do for you?

design_notes: Simple oval leaf design (like picking a leaf off the ground). Eyes on leaf surface, friendly smile. Longer arms and legs. Faithful to drawing. Ready for testing on Realm.
